name: Ōnan (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōnan town emblem in blue: a blue stylised swirl enclosing a white trefoil.
history: Municipal flag of Ōnan, a town in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Ōnan town emblem — a blue stylised swirl enclosing a white trefoil
